notes.title: Calling All Artists: Showcase Your Art in BattleCards Saga!
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce a special BattleCards Saga art contest! If you’re an artist who loves creating imaginative creatures, this is your chance to see your art featured in our card game on Steam.

[u]How It Works:[/u]
We’re looking for illustrated designs of simple animals or hybrids that align with the current creatures in the game. Selected artworks will be added to the game’s collection, with credit given to the artist. Your name will appear in the in-game gallery alongside your illustration.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45180085/f21f5c8e61e6f6d9595c67a286f138523d104253.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45180085/e9e0c4ac10fa056bc45a34a7759a30991bb99ee3.png[/img][/url]

You can submit multiple proposals, and all submissions will be carefully reviewed. However, please note that final selections are at our discretion based on game integration needs.

[u]Art Submission Guidelines:[/u]
Format: Square (1:1 aspect ratio).
Positioning: The character should be centered within the image.
Deadline: Submissions must be sent by March 31, 2025.
Integration: Selected artworks will be added to the game during Q2 2025.
[u]How to Submit:[/u]
Send your artwork to glhfgamestudio(at)gmail.com with your artist information (name or alias to be displayed in the gallery).

If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to us via email.

This contest is all about celebrating and showcasing the talent of artists. We’re looking forward to seeing your incredible creations!

Good luck and happy illustrating!
GLHF Studio

notes.title: Post-Launch News for BattleCards Saga
notes.content:
Hey BattleCards adventurers! 

Since launch, I’ve been working to make the game deeper and more engaging. Looking ahead to 2025, I’m planning a [b]new quest system[/b] with a unique resource earned through victories. This will allow you to permanently boost your creatures’ traits and races, unlocking bonuses that reward dedicated players by letting them push further with stronger, customized creatures.

In 2025, I’ll also be introducing new modes like Infinite Mode for endless strategy testing and Ranked Mode, where your teams will face those of other players, bringing fresh, dynamic challenges.

In parallel, my studio 'GLHF Studio' is also working on a second (with short production) game, a multiplayer shoot 'em up (shmup), with a demo coming in February 2025! The multiplayer mechanics we’re building for this shmup will pave the way for adapting Battlecards Saga with future multiplayer options.

Your feedback is incredibly valuable, so feel free to share any constructive ideas to help me keep improving the game. Thanks for all your support, and stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Patch notes 1.2.71
notes.content:
Entry Limit: Leaderboard now displays the top 15 entries
Improved Display: Toggle button to show or hide the leaderboard

notes.title: Patch notes 1.2.62
notes.content: Fixed an issue where rating would reset on game startup due to a development leftover. This prevented players from retaining their progress between sessions. Now, MMR will consistently save and load correctly, allowing for smooth and uninterrupted progression.

notes.title: Patch 1.2.61 - Sounds loop and rating corrections
notes.content:
Patch Notes 1.2.61 :

    Improved MMR display animation from previous to updated values, making changes clearer with a smooth transition
    Fixed MMR update to only display the change (+/-) value for better clarity
    Added persistent MMR save in PlayerPrefs to track progress even after game restarts
    Ensured UI elements reset properly between rounds, eliminating leftover visuals from previous sessions
    Implemented continuous audio loop functionality, refining the in-game sound experience

notes.title: BattleCards Saga is officially launched
notes.content:
BattleCards Saga is officially launched! I’m genuinely happy with how far this project has come, especially as my very first game. The support from everyone who tested the game has been invaluable, making this so much richer, thank you all!

The game itself will continue to evolve over time, with updates a few times a year as opportunities arise and as I grow in my own coding and development skills. This evolution will also depend greatly on your feedback and the excitement for this unique game mechanic, so your input truly shapes the future of BattleCards Saga.

I’m also open to new versions of the game with different artistic renderings. I’d love to collaborate with artists interested in creating visual interpretations to add even more depth and style to the game’s world.

For any publishers out there, from all horizons, my door is open to proposals, new ideas, and potential partnerships, whether it’s for BattleCards Saga or future projects that we can bring to life together.

While the in-game content is a bit different from what I initially envisioned given the timeframe, I’m proud of what I was able to create. Expect regular updates that will fine-tune the balance and bring more polish to the experience.

For launch week, BattleCards Saga is available at 25% off the desired price, dropping from $12.99 to under $10 (9,74$). While this may seem like a lot to some and little to others, it’s important to know that the game will receive regular updates in the future, with new options and enhancements. This price point is also a way to support the ongoing development of the project; setting the price too low from the start wouldn’t reflect the work put into it. I’m aware that the game doesn’t (yet) compete with larger studio titles, but it will only grow and improve over time. Thank you for your support !

If you’d like to support this project, feel free to join the community on Discord or follow along on social media, Instagram is where I’m most active. Thanks again for being a part of BattleCards Saga!

notes.title: Update Tutorial
notes.content:
[b]Update Announcement: New Tutorial and Upcoming Improvements![/b]

Greetings, Heroes of Battlecards Saga!

We’ve heard your feedback, and we’re excited to roll out a new update that includes a full tutorial explaining the core mechanics of the game. We understand that some aspects were not as clear as they should be, and this tutorial will help guide you through the fundamentals to ensure you’re ready for battle!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45180085/f6993b9c8ecc542f2d7387d8e1046f5080c3d0f6.gif[/img][img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45180085/824ea8eb15de0c6e8cd3b317d54be1f745deeefa.gif[/img][img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45180085/ed137e1291071c9c770b90271ab3dae06f2819b8.gif[/img]

Additionally, based on feedback from Steam Next Fest, we will be making changes to ensure the game is more rewarding and gratifying for players. We're committed to improving the progression and enhancing the experience with more satisfying victories and valuable rewards.


As always, your reviews and wishlists are greatly appreciated and help us shape the future of Battlecards Saga. Thank you for your support, and we look forward to seeing you in the arena!

GLHF Studio
